title: 2022年度 第3回検定一次試験 英検3級 リスニング

parts.name: 第1部
parts.description: イラストを参考にしながら対話を聞き、その最後の文に対する応答として最も適切なものを選ぶ形式です。

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: These grapes are delicious.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: You should take some home with you.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Is that OK?

questions.question: What is the best response?
questions.explanation: 「本当にいいの？」→許可を求めている。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「お腹がすいた」→無関係。2「もちろんいいよ」→正解。3「よくできた」→無関係。
highlights: Is that OK?

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: This artist’s paintings are really interesting.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: I agree.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Do you know where he’s from?

questions.question: What is the best response?
questions.explanation: 「彼がどこの出身か知ってる？」→出身地を尋ねている。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「隣の部屋にある」→場所。2「カナダ人だと思う」→正解。3「色が好き」→感想。
highlights: Do you know where he's from?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: I hear you’re moving to France.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: That’s right.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: What will you do there?

questions.question: What is the best response?
choices: I’m going to teach at a university.
I like Spanish food the best.
questions.explanation: 「そこで何をするつもり？」→将来の予定を聞いている。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「大学で教えるつもり」→正解。2「スペイン料理が好き」→無関係。3「パスポートをなくした」→無関係。
highlights: What will you do there?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: I’d like to send this package to Osaka.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: OK.  Anything else?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: No, that’s all.

questions.question: What is the best response?
questions.explanation: 「以上です」→それ以上用事がない。店員の返答。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「行ったことがある」→無関係。2「800円になります」→正解。3「あちらです」→場所。
highlights: No, that's all.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Thanks for going shopping.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: No problem.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: What’s this?  Cookies weren’t on the shopping list.

questions.question: What is the best response?
questions.explanation: 「クッキーは買い物リストになかったよ」→リストにない物を買った理由。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「30分間」→時間。2「箱がたくさんある」→無関係。3「本当に欲しかったんだ」→正解。
highlights: Cookies weren't on the shopping list.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: I made this dress.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Yeah.  What do you think of it?

questions.question: What is the best response?
questions.explanation: 「どう思う？」→自作ドレスへの感想を求めている。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「素敵に見える」→正解。2「昨日買った」→自作なのに。3「パーティーが始まった」→無関係。
highlights: What do you think of it?

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Excuse me, Mr. Walker.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Hi, Tina.  Can I help you?

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Is Ms. Harper in the teachers’ room?

questions.question: What is the best response?
choices: No, but she’ll be back soon.
No, but I teach that subject.
questions.explanation: 「ハーパー先生は職員室にいますか？」→先生の所在を尋ねている。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「いいえ、でも生徒だよ」→無関係。2「いいえ、でもすぐ戻る」→正解。3「いいえ、でもその科目を教えている」→無関係。
highlights: Is Ms. Harper in the teachers' room?

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Is there a post office on this road?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Which side of the road is it on?

questions.question: What is the best response?
questions.explanation: 「道のどちら側にありますか？」→郵便局の位置。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「右側です」→正解。2「運転が好き」→無関係。3「手紙を送った」→無関係。
highlights: Which side of the road is it on?

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Do you want some ice cream?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: No, I’ve already had some today.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: When?

questions.question: What is the best response?
questions.explanation: 「いつ？」→アイスを食べた時間を聞いている。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「毎日1時間」→期間。2「学生だった頃」→過去の経験。3「昼食の後」→正解。
highlights: When?

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: What happened, Mark?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: I hurt my leg at soccer practice.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Oh no!  I’ll carry your bag.

questions.question: What is the best response?
questions.explanation: 「かばんを持ってあげるよ」→申し出への返答。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「ありがとう」→正解。2「楽しいスポーツだ」→無関係。3「君もできるよ」→無関係。
highlights: I'll carry your bag.

parts.name: 第2部
parts.description: 対話を聞き、その質問に対して最も適切な答えを1, 2, 3, 4の中から一つ選ぶ形式です。

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Mark, it’s time for dinner.  Are those Jessica’s books on the table?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: No, Mom.  They’re Dad’s.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Can you move them?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Sure.

questions.question: Whose books are on the table?
questions.explanation: テーブルの上の本は誰の？→「パパのだよ」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「ジェシカの」→違う。2「お母さんの」→違う。3「お父さんの」→正解。4「マークの」→違う。
highlights: They're Dad's.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Let’s go running this weekend.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: OK, but I’m busy on Sunday.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: How about after lunch on Saturday, then?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Perfect.  I’ll see you around two.

questions.question: When will they go running?
questions.explanation: いつ走りに行く？→「土曜の昼食後、2時頃」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「土曜の午前」→違う。2「土曜の午後」→正解。3「日曜の午前」→忙しい。4「日曜の午後」→忙しい。
highlights: after lunch on Saturday
around two

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Ken, can you go to the store for me?  I need some carrots.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Sure, Mom.  What are you making for dinner?

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Beef and vegetable stew.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Sounds good.

questions.question: What does Ken’s mother ask him to do?
questions.explanation: お母さんはケンに何を頼んだ？→「にんじんを買ってきて」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「公園に行く」→違う。2「にんじんを買う」→違う。3「お店に行く」→正解。4「台所を掃除する」→違う。
highlights: can you go to the store
I need some carrots

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Mary, I can’t study.  Can you and your friends be quiet?

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: I’m sorry.  We’ll go downstairs and watch TV.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: No problem.

questions.question: What does the boy ask Mary and her friends to do?
questions.explanation: 男の子はメアリーと友達に何を頼んだ？→「静かにして」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「静かにする」→正解。2「テレビを見る」→メアリーの提案。3「下に行く」→メアリーの提案。4「一緒に勉強する」→違う。
highlights: Can you and your friends be quiet?

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Let’s take the bus to the gym today.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: It’s sunny, so why don’t we ride our bikes?

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Sorry, mine is broken.  Do you want to walk?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: OK.

questions.question: How will they go to the gym?
questions.explanation: どうやってジムに行く？→「自転車は壊れている→歩く」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「バスで」→最初の提案。2「自転車で」→壊れている。3「車で」→違う。4「徒歩で」→正解。
highlights: Do you want to walk?
OK.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: You’re good at playing the drums.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Thanks.  I practice for two hours every day.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: I’m in a rock band.  Do you want to join it?

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: I’d love to.

questions.question: What does the boy want the girl to do?
questions.explanation: 男の子は女の子に何をしてほしい？→「バンドに入って」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「2時間ドラムを練習する」→違う。2「家でドラムを練習する」→違う。3「バンドに入る」→違う。4「バンドに入る」→正解。
highlights: Do you want to join it?

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Have you been to the new café by the library?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Yes.  The coffee is delicious.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: And how about the food?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: It was expensive and not very healthy.

questions.question: What did the man say about the café?
questions.explanation: 男性はカフェについて何と言った？→「食べ物は高くて健康的でない」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「食べ物が良い」→違う。2「コーヒーが高い」→コーヒーはおいしい。3「食べ物が高い」→正解。4「コーヒーがまずい」→おいしい。
highlights: It was expensive and not very healthy.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Those are cool shoes, Josh.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Thanks, Kristen.  I got them yesterday at the mall by the hospital.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: How much were they?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Only $50.

questions.question: What did Josh do yesterday?
questions.explanation: ジョシュは昨日何をした？→「モールで靴を買った」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「靴を買った」→違う。2「靴を買った」→正解。3「学校に行った」→違う。4「クリステンを訪ねた」→違う。
highlights: I got them yesterday at the mall

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: The sky is so blue and clear today.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Yeah, there aren’t any clouds.  But tomorrow will be rainy.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Really?  It just rained yesterday.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: The weather has been strange recently.

questions.question: How is the weather today?
questions.explanation: 今日の天気は？→「空は青くて晴れ、雲がない」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「晴れ」→正解。2「雨」→明日。3「曇り」→雲がない。4「風が強い」→違う。
highlights: The sky is so blue and clear
there aren't any clouds

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Excuse me.  What time does this store close today?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: At seven.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: I see.  Does it close at seven every night?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: No.  On Sundays, it closes one hour earlier, at six.

questions.question: What time does the store close on Sundays?
questions.explanation: 日曜日は何時に閉まる？→「1時間早く6時」。
highlights: On Sundays, it closes one hour earlier, at six.

parts.name: 第3部
parts.description: 英文を聞き、その質問に対して最も適切な答えを1, 2, 3, 4の中から一つ選ぶ形式です。

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Last summer, Sarah and her family moved to a new city.  At first, Sarah was lonely.  But after she started school, she met many students.  Now she has lots of friends, so she’s happy.

questions.question: Why is Sarah happy now?
questions.explanation: なぜサラは今幸せ？→「たくさん友達ができたから」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「最初は幸せだった」→寂しかった。2「友達がたくさんいる」→正解。3「冬に引っ越した」→夏。4「新しい仕事を始めた」→学校。
highlights: Now she has lots of friends, so she's happy.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: The ski jackets in my favorite shop are over $300.  But this week, they’re 50 percent off. They’re only $150.  I’ll buy one tomorrow.

questions.question: How much does a ski jacket cost this week?
questions.explanation: 今週のスキージャケットの値段は？→「50%オフで150ドル」。
highlights: they're 50 percent off
They're only $150.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: I always do my homework before dinner.  After dinner, I like to call my friends from school. I enjoy talking with them about music and movies.

questions.question: What does the girl like to do after dinner?
questions.explanation: 夕食後に何をするのが好き？→「友達に電話する」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「友達に電話する」→正解。2「映画を見る」→話題。3「宿題をする」→夕食前。4「音楽を聴く」→話題。
highlights: After dinner, I like to call my friends

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Attention, everyone.  The train to Hampton Zoo will arrive one hour late.  We’re very sorry. If you’re in a hurry, please go to the bus station across the road and take the Number 5 bus.

questions.question: What is the problem?
questions.explanation: 問題は何？→「電車が1時間遅れる」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「電車が満員」→違う。2「バスが運行していない」→違う。3「電車が遅れる」→正解。4「バス停が閉まっている」→違う。
highlights: The train to Hampton Zoo will arrive one hour late.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Many people thought Simon would play tennis in junior high school because his mother was a famous tennis player.  But Simon joined the soccer club.  In high school, he wants to try volleyball.

questions.question: Which club did Simon join in junior high school?
questions.explanation: サイモンは中学で何部に入った？→「サッカー部」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「テニス」→お母さん。2「バスケ」→違う。3「サッカー」→正解。4「バレーボール」→高校の希望。
highlights: But Simon joined the soccer club.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Jenny loves making cakes and cookies with her mother.  They often listen to music while they bake.  Her brother likes to help by cleaning the kitchen.

questions.question: What does Jenny like to do?
questions.explanation: ジェニーは何をするのが好き？→「お母さんとケーキやクッキーを作る」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「焼き菓子を作る」→違う。2「焼き菓子を作る」→正解。3「一人で音楽を聴く」→一緒に。4「兄と遊ぶ」→掃除を手伝う。
highlights: Jenny loves making cakes and cookies

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Oscar likes to paint pictures of bicycles and his dad’s boat.  His mom bought him a book about art, but his dad thinks he should study other subjects more.

questions.question: What does Oscar enjoy doing?
questions.explanation: オスカーは何を楽しんでいる？→「自転車やボートの絵を描く」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「美術の本を読む」→お母さんが買った。2「自転車に乗る」→描く。3「他の科目を勉強する」→お父さんの意見。4「絵を描く」→正解。
highlights: Oscar likes to paint pictures

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: I usually eat lunch with my friends at college, but my aunt and cousin are staying at my house now.  Tomorrow, I’ll meet my cousin for lunch.  I’m going to take her to my favorite noodle shop.

questions.question: Who will the girl have lunch with tomorrow?
questions.explanation: 明日誰と昼食を食べる？→「いとこ」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「いとこ」→正解。2「おば」→泊まりに来ている。3「大学の友達」→普段。4「お母さん」→違う。
highlights: I'll meet my cousin for lunch.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: I wanted to go out with my friends last night, but I stayed home because my son caught a cold.  My wife will be home tomorrow, so I’m going to meet my friends to see a movie.

questions.question: Why did the man stay home last night?
questions.explanation: なぜ男性は昨夜家にいた？→「息子が風邪をひいたから」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「映画に行った」→今日の予定。2「妻がいなかった」→明日帰る。3「息子が病気」→正解。4「仕事が遅かった」→違う。
highlights: my son caught a cold

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Tomorrow, I’m going to a music festival with my friend from college.  My friend lives far from my house, so we’ll meet at the museum and walk from there.  I’m really looking forward to it.

questions.question: Where will the girl meet her friend?
questions.explanation: どこで友達と待ち合わせる？→「博物館」。
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「博物館で」→正解。2「大学で」→違う。3「フェスティバルで」→行き先。4「自宅で」→遠い。
highlights: we'll meet at the museum
